stories.title: Popular Smokies hiking trail renovated and reopened
stories.summary: The Smokies' Bullhead Trail reopens after a major rehabilitation funded by Friends of the Smokies, restoring safety and accessibility to the fire-damaged path.

stories.title: 'Remind a child that someone cares' | Mission of Hope launches 2026 Blue Barrel campaign Nov. 20
stories.summary: Mission of Hope's annual Blue Barrel campaign starts Friday, providing toys, clothes and essentials to thousands of Appalachian families in need this holiday season.

stories.title: Youngest Republican in Tennessee General Assembly elected for key leadership role in Tennessee House
stories.summary: At 26, State Rep. Noah Smith has been elected Assistant Floor Leader for Tennessee's House Republican Caucus, marking a notable rise from his school board origins.

stories.title: Wilberforce Academy of Knoxville files to open Christian Charter School
stories.summary: It marks a change since the Tennessee Public Charter Schools Act of 2002 was passed, requiring all charter schools in the state to be nonsectarian and nonreligious.

stories.title: Oak Ridge National Laboratory nuclear physicist wins APS Bonner Prize after decades of work
stories.summary: Officials at Oak Ridge National Laboratory said David Radford will be awarded the American Physical Society's 2027 Tom W. Bonner Prize in Nuclear Physics.

stories.title: Knoxville City Council members push to provide more shelter access on cold nights
stories.summary: Councilmembers aim to expand shelter space for the unhoused during extreme weather, with a proposed ordinance raising temperature thresholds for emergency services.

stories.title: Fire burning in Greene County grows to 500 acres, crosses into Hawkins County
stories.summary: As of 4 a.m. on Thursday, the fire near Caney Creek Lane was 50% contained. Thursday afternoon, officials said it had also crossed into the Beech Creek community.

stories.title: Hometown Heart: Mission of Hope celebrates 30 years
stories.summary: Mission of Hope started as an idea in the mid '90s. Now, 30 years later, the nonprofit is celebrating how many kids they have helped survive in rural Appalachia.

stories.title: TBI: 18-year-old dead after confrontation with Lake Tansi police
stories.summary: The TBI is investigating the incident and said the deceased was armed with a box cutter.

stories.title: Scientists identified remains found in McMinn Co. in 1991. Now detectives want to know what led to the man's death
stories.summary: The Tennessee Bureau of Investigation seeks public help to uncover the mystery behind the death of Forest Wayne Loudermilk, whose remains were recently identified.

stories.title: ‘No Disc Included’: Digital-only Grand Theft Auto 6 raises concerns for gamers in rural East Tennessee
stories.summary: With its digital-only release, Grand Theft Auto 6 sparks concern among gamers with limited internet access.

stories.title: Rural Metro Fire conducting prescribed burn in East Knox County
stories.summary: Officials with Rural Metro Fire said they are assisting the Tennessee Department of Environment and Conservation at Seven Island State Birding Park in Kodak.
